A0160.title: Code Audit and Bug Bounty
A0160.definition: Conduct multi-party audits and establish bug bounty programs to incentivize vulnerability discovery
A0160.description: Collect and report characteristics such as contract code, permission configurations, asset flows, and dependency components before and after launch. Introduce internal code audits, third-party security audits, public vulnerability bounty programs, and continuous retesting mechanisms. Identify security issues in contract logic, permissions, and cross-chain interactions through multi-source review and baseline comparison.
A0160.limitation: Code audits and vulnerability bounties cannot guarantee the discovery of all defects. Effectiveness depends on audit scope, audit depth, bounty attractiveness, and remediation closure. Re-evaluation is required after business logic changes.
